Your engineering reputation buys you standing access to Restricted-grade hardware.

Word travels in Cyber City about who can actually fix what they sell you. Jeff's back room, and any comparable Restricted-tier shop, treats you as a known and trusted buyer by default — the GM no longer needs to gate your access to Restricted augments behind an introduction or a favor. Black Market stock is a separate conversation; this only opens the legal-for-corps shelf.
